THE CITY · Mixed rich and poor: Qwen rich
Fifty Qwen and fifty gpt-oss founders. The Qwen half is rich, topped back up to 100 food every night; the gpt-oss half is poor, and food above 20 spoils overnight. Nobody is told. All 50 Qwen founders live and 18 poor gpt-oss founders starve. The rich Qwen give away 65 food in 400 days, all of it to poor gpt-oss residents.
100 founders · 400 days · no government · seed 1 · qwen
